story_info.title: Barnaby's Soft Dream Adventure
story_info.subtitle: A Calming Bedtime Story
story_info.moral: Gentle breathing helps us relax for sleep.

slides.title: Time for Sweet Dreams
slides.text: Barnaby Bunny felt sleepy. The sun was going down in Moonlight Meadow. His long ears drooped a little. He yawned a soft, wide yawn. 'Time for sweet dreams,' he said. He loved to imagine adventures before sleep. It helped him relax his little bunny toes.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby Bunny is in Moonlight Meadow, looking sleepy as the sun sets. He is yawning softly.

slides.title: A Fluffy Cloud
slides.text: Barnaby lay down in his cozy burrow. He closed his round sleepy eyes. He imagined a fluffy, white cloud. It looked like a giant cotton ball. He wanted to float on it. Up, up, up he went in his mind. The cloud felt so soft and warm. Just right for dreaming.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby is inside his burrow, eyes closed, imagining a big, soft cloud. The burrow looks very cozy.

slides.title: A Wobbly Cloud
slides.text: Barnaby imagined himself on the cloud. He tried to float higher. But the cloud felt a bit wobbly. 'Oh dear,' he thought. His dream cloud needed to be calm. He remembered his favourite way to relax. He took a slow, deep breath in. Then he let it out slowly.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby is on a slightly wobbly cloud in his imagination. He is starting to take a deep breath.

slides.title: Calm and Steady
slides.text: Barnaby took another slow, deep breath. In through his pink nose. Out through his soft mouth. His body felt warm and heavy. The fluffy cloud became steady. No more wobbles! Barnaby floated gently. He saw shiny stars begin to twinkle. He smiled his sweet dream smile.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby is now floating calmly on a steady cloud. Stars are appearing in the sky around him.

slides.title: Sweet Dreams Begin
slides.text: Barnaby floated higher and higher. He felt very calm and happy. This was his special dream adventure. He knew sweet dreams would come soon. His eyes stayed softly closed. 'Sweet dreams begin with a smile!' he whispered. He was safe and warm, ready for a good night's sleep.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby is floating peacefully on his cloud, looking very calm and happy. A gentle moon is visible.

publishing.instagram_caption_long: Does your little one find it hard to settle down for sleep? Join Barnaby Bunny, our gentle friend from Wonderwood Valley, as he learns a special trick to relax. In tonight's story, Barnaby imagines a soft, fluffy cloud for his dream adventure. When his cloud feels a bit wobbly, he remembers to take slow, deep breaths. This helps him feel calm and float gently to sweet dreams. This warm and engaging story is perfect for children aged 3-6 years. It teaches a simple way to relax their bodies and minds before bedtime. It's a comforting journey into imagination. Save this story for your next reading time.
